title: ISL & TLC Waterfall Countertops
description:
Omitted due to NDA: technical drawings, ideation on internal features, weight-reducing features, market research and packaging design.

Through market research and surveys from Motech customers, this was the most requested product: a waterfall countertop for both kitchen islands and bathroom vanities. Further research quickly made us realize this was unrealistic for most companies due to the cost of manufacturing and shipping. Thanks to my fabrication and generative CAD background, and a seemingly endless amount of prototyping and ideation, an internal weight-reducing structure for our resin molds was procedurally generated to make this challenge a reality.
research_intro: Public market data shows why a waterfall top was worth solving: vanities and kitchen islands are a large, steadily growing category, and the quartz look is what buyers ask for. Motech's own survey results stay out under NDA.

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: Customers' most-requested product was a waterfall countertop, but solid-surface waterfalls are heavy and expensive to make and ship.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: A cast resin waterfall top with a procedurally generated internal structure that takes weight out of the mold, refined through many rounds of prototyping.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Vanity brands such as Wyndham Collection, Virtu USA, Kohler and IKEA, with quartz surfaces from Caesarstone, Cambria and Silestone setting the look buyers expect.
